primary_meaning: Jesus Christ as the conquering Lion of the tribe of Judah, symbolizing royal power, strength, majesty, and victory

alternatives.meaning: Satan/the devil as a roaring lion seeking to devour
General emblem of strength, courage, ferocity, or royal majesty (applied to persons, nations, or qualities)
One of the four living creatures (often linked in tradition to a Gospel writer, especially Mark)

notes: Christian interpretation recognizes multiple well-attested symbolic uses rather than a single exclusive meaning; the Christological Lion of Judah is the most iconic positive usage, while the Satanic roaring lion is the most common negative counterpart, both widely taught.
